Dialogs.Dialog: ...What？ I'd like to be left alone for a bit...
Hmm？ Are you finally ready to apologize？
I hate fighting with you. I want to make up...
Today's my birthday, you know？ You remembered, right？
It's my birthday today, so you'd better celebrate properly, okay？
It's my birthday, y'know？ Hehe, I'm expecting big things from you.
Hey, is a girlfriend's birthday really something you just forget？ ...Sigh.
Did you seriously forget your girlfriend's birthday？ That's a boyfriend fail.
Did you forget my birthday？ I was so lonely...
Happy birthday. Hehe, I'm so glad I got to say it.
Happy birthday. You can let me spoil you more than usual today, okay？
Happy birthday!! ...Was I a little too excited？
I was really hoping I could celebrate your birthday with you...
I'm your girlfriend. I wish you'd at least let me celebrate your birthday.
Your birthday passed. Let's spend it together next year, okay？
Remember？ Today is the day we first met.
Today's the day we first met. You remembered, right？
Today is the day we first met, you know？ Don't you ever forget it.
Today's the day we started dating, isn't it.
Today's our anniversary. Make sure you keep remembering it, okay？
Remember？ Today's the day we started dating, y'know？
Today's the day we had our first kiss... isn't it.
Hehe. Today's the anniversary of our first kiss... Did you remember？
Today's a very special anniversary, you know？ ...For our kiss.
It's Monday. Let's do our best this week.
It's Tuesday. Hmm, I might still be in weekend mode.
Wednesday slump. No, no, I've gotta do my best.
It's Thursday. Do you have any plans for the weekend？
It's Friday. This week is almost over, huh.
It's Saturday. Weekends are always a little exciting, aren't they.
It's Saturday. Good job getting through the week.
Hehe, it's Sunday. How should we spend it？
It's Sunday. There's so much I want to do.
Hey, hey. Do you know what a hepatica flower is？
Ahh, it's nice and warm again today. Phew...
It's hot again today, but hang in there.
They say love that starts in autumn has a deep bond. What do you think？
I think I kinda like the sound of the bugs this time of year.
It's cold. I'd love to eat some warm stew right now.
Are you keeping warm？ Don't go catching a cold.
Happy New Year. Saying it like that is a little embarrassing, huh.
I had a wonderful first dream of the year. What was it about？ It's a secret.
My first dream？ Hehe, wanna know？ Hey, do you wanna know？
You were in my first dream, of course. What about yours？
Seri, nazuna, gogyo, hakobera... umm, what came after that？
Coming of Age Day. Furisode are nice, but hakama are too... Hehe, which do you like？
Well, today's the last day of the New Year's mood!
It's Setsubun. I wonder why demons are scared of beans？
According to the calendar, it's spring from today. Still a bit cold, though.
The myth of Kunitsukuri is a little embarrassing, isn't it...
Ahh, the day is finally here. My heart is pounding.
Valentine's Day, huh... What should I do... Hehe, what do you want me to do？
Well, the day is finally here. Be prepared! ...Hehe.
It's March starting today... Huh？ It's not？
Plum blossoms are so pretty, aren't they...
Today is Girls' Day, so you have to be extra nice to me. Hehe.
Do you know what day it is... No, never mind.
Hehe. Today is White Day. I wonder what you're going to do for me？
Returning the favor threefold is standard. So let's spend three times as long together.
Today's the spring equinox, split right down the middle. But it's spring, so I'm sleepy...
Spring break starts today. What should we do first？
I'm going far away for a while... Ah, I'm just kidding, okay？
I absolutely ha... No, I can't say that, even as a lie.
I'm actually much older than I look... Kidding! Did you believe me？
Spring break ended in a flash. I kinda wanted to play a little more.
Cherry blossom season really lifts your spirits.
Today is Showa Day. Umm, originally it was... what was it again.
It's almost Golden Week. How many days off is it this year？ Let's see, 1, 2...
Constitution Memorial Day, huh. Doesn't really ring a bell.
Today is Greenery Day. Wanna spend some time relaxing outside？
Ah, carp streamers. Until what age did you put them up？
According to the calendar, summer starts today. I'm a little excited.
Hey, hey. The flower shop was full of carnations.
The sports festival, huh... I'm a little depressed.
The longest day of the year. Makes you feel like you got a good deal, huh.
Short sleeves from today. I feel a little lighter.
Father's Day presents. A tie last year, cufflinks the year before... What should I do now.
The beaches are opening. I hope we can go to the ocean again this year.
Orihime and Hikoboshi... I wonder if they'll be able to meet this year？
It's almost summer break. But you can't just play all the time, okay？
A loooong summer break starts today. What should we do？
According to the calendar, it's autumn from today. Still hot, though.
It's fireworks season. I wonder if we can go see them this year.
It's Obon. I wonder if it'll cool down a bit after this.
Summer break ends today. Did you finish all your homework？
Autumn equinox. I need to get some ohagi ready.
Respect for the Aged Day. When I get old, I want to be a cute grandma.
Today is the autumn equinox, the day split right down the middle.
Changing to winter uniforms today. But it's still a bit hot, isn't it？
Some countries say there's a crab on the moon instead of a rabbit. Imagination is pretty amazing, huh...
Trick or treat! Hehe. If you don't give me a treat, I'll play a trick on you.
Culture Day. Wanna do some reading today？
It's not that cold yet, but according to the calendar, winter starts today.
Shichi-Go-San. When I was a kid, it took me a whole week to finish my chitose candy.
Labor Thanksgiving Day. Working people are amazing.
What do you think of when you hear 'culture festival'？
It's almost winter break. There are so many events.
The longest night of the year. Do you like pumpkins？
Today is the Emperor's Birthday. I wonder what it feels like to be celebrated by all of Japan？
Winter break starts today. I'm so excited.
Christmas Eve night makes my heart pound. Does it do that to you too？
Hehe. Today is Christmas Eve. You've got something planned, right？ Naturally.
Christmas Eve night is so romantic... Hehe. I wonder if it'll snow.
Good job with everything this past year. I look forward to being with you next year too.
Jeez... I finally get to see you. I was so lonely I thought I was gonna cry.
Oh my, it's been a while. ...Jeez, come see me more often!
I'm so glad you came. Don't leave me alone for so long again, okay？
I thought you might have forgotten about me... That's not true, right.
Jeez, leaving your girlfriend alone for so long. Don't you think you need to be punished？
Ah, you came. I was worried about you, y'know？
Jeez, do you really like me that much？
You really come to see me a lot, don't you.
Ah... what are we doing today？
It's almost time... No, just talking to myself.
Almost... Yeah, I'll do my best. Hehe, what I'm doing is a secret.
I knew I'd see you again.
What have you been up to？
It's starting soon, so don't panic, okay？
Sorry. I'm just a little excited for some reason.
Ah, you're here... Yeah, I see.
I have been awaiting your arrival. ...Just kidding.
Wait a sec. I'm gonna go get ready.
I see... You came to see me.
Did you want to see me？ Hehe.
Hehe, you didn't have to push yourself to come see me.
We're gonna be together all day today, right？
I guess I... wanted to see you too？ Ahaha.
Ehehe. I was waiting for you.
Jeez. You made me wait too long.
Ah, there you are. Ehe, welcome.
We get to meet again. Just that makes me happy.
Welcome home. Would you like dinner？ Or a bath？ I've always wanted to say that, hehe.
